title: Labyrinthulomycete DNA extraction
author: Jackie L. Collier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n83dhyn

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary extraction buffer and stock solutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare extraction buffer containing 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 50 mM NaCl, 10 mM EDTA, and 0.5% SDS.

Prepare or obtain stocks of proteinase K (10 mg/ml), RNAse A (25 mg/ml), phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), 3M NaOAc (sodium acetate), 100% ethanol, and 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Collect and wash the cell biomass.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells from liquid culture or wash from agar plate at 4000xg (C0650 rotor) for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash pellet in 50% artificial seawater, then in ddwater.
Perform a final spin and weigh the pellet.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells and digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend ~100 mg wet weight fresh cell pellet in 1 ml extraction buffer supplemented with 100 ug/ml proteinase K.
Incubate for 45 minutes at 50C.
Add 100 ug/ml RNAse A.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 37C.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform organic extraction to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).
Mix gently for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge gently at ~8,000 x g for 10 minutes to separate phases.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
Repeat the extraction process.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second organic extraction to remove residual phenol.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Mix gently for ~5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge gently at ~8,000 x g for 10 minutes to separate phases if needed.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
Repeat the extraction process.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Precipitate and collect the genomic DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M NaOAc.
Add 2 volumes of ice-cold 100% ethanol.
Collect the precipitated DNA (fluffy ball) by spooling onto a glass rod (e.g., a Pasteur pipette with the open end melted closed).
Wash the DNA by dipping it in 70% ethanol.
Air dry the DNA.

steps.title: DNA Dissolution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the recovered DNA in a suitable buffer.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the DNA in ~100-350 microliters of water or TE (pH 8.0), depending on the initial biomass amount.
